content.text:
===== compose.yml =====
name: audiominer-local


services:

  redis:
    image: library/redis:7


######################################################
#  Web-Oberfläche
######################################################
  web-service:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-}audiominer/web-service:${TAG:-dev}
    volumes:
      - ./.local/data/ws:/data
      - ./web-service.default.yml:/app/web-service.default.yml
      - ./ui_custom/config.json:/app/ui/config.json
      - ./ui_custom/pages:/app/ui/pages
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1:8090:8090
    links:
      - redis

######################################################
#  Verzeichnisüberwachungsdienst
######################################################

  fs-watcher:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-}audiominer/fs-watcher:${TAG:-dev}
    environment:
      APP_UID: ${APP_UID:-0}
      APP_GID: ${APP_GID:-0}
    volumes:
      - ./.local/data/fsw:/data
      - type: bind
        source: ./watch
        target: /mnt
      - ./fs-watcher.default.yml:/app/fs-watcher.default.yml
    links:
      - redis


######################################################
#  Benachrichtigungsdienst für den Mailversand
######################################################
#
#  notify-service:
#    image: ${REGISTRY:-}audiominer/notify-service:${TAG:-dev}
#    volumes:
#      - ./.local/data/ntf:/data
#      - ./notify-service.default.yml:/app/notify-service.default.yml
#    links:
#      - redis



===== compose.cpu.yml =====
name: audiominer-local


services:


######################################################
#  Transkriptionsdienst (CPU Variante)
######################################################
  asr-service:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-}audiominer/asr-service:${TAG:-dev}
    environment:
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN}
    volumes:
      - ./.local/models:/models
      - ./.local/data/asr:/data
      - ./asr-service.cpu.default.yml:/app/asr-service.default.yml
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1:8091:8090
    external_links:
      - redis


===== compose.gpu.yml =====
name: audiominer-local


services:


######################################################
#  Transkriptionsdienst (GPU Variante)
######################################################
  asr-service:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-}audiominer/asr-service-gpu:${TAG:-dev}
    environment:
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN}
    volumes:
      - ./.local/models:/models
      - ./.local/data/asr:/data
      - ./asr-service.gpu.default.yml:/app/asr-service.default.yml
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1:8091:8090
    external_links:
      - redis
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              capabilities:
                - gpu

===== .env-example =====
# Example env file copy to .env
REGISTRY=registry.opencode.de/bpa/audiominer/
DEPENDENCY_PROXY=registry.opencode.de/bpa/audiominer/
TAG=latest
APP_UID=1000
APP_GID=1000
HF_TOKEN=hier-dein-token

===== web-service.default.yml =====
ui_dir: /app/ui
upload_dir: /data/upload
extract_dir: /data/extract

logging:
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG
  version: 1

message_queue:
  name: web-service
  host: redis
  port: 6379

server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8090

database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/web_service.db'
  options:
    pool_size: 10
    max_overflow: 20



===== asr-service.cpu.default.yml =====
upload_dir: /data/upload


# logging.config.dictConfig
logging:
  version: 1
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  log_dir: /data/logs
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG
  loggers:
    websockets.client:
      handlers:
        - stdout
      level: INFO
      propagate: false


server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8090

database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/asr-service.db'

message_queue:
  name: asr
  host: redis
  port: 6379


jobs:
  worker: 2

language_detector:
  fallback: de
  probability: 0.65
  supported:
    - de
    - fr
    - en

model_settings:
  default:
    align:
      align_model: null
      interpolate_method: nearest
      no_align: false
      return_char_alignments: null
    align_model: null
    asr:
      beam_size: 5
      compression_ratio_threshold: 2.4
      condition_on_previous_text: false
      initial_prompt: null
      length_penalty: 1.0
      log_prob_threshold: -1.0
      no_speech_threshold: 0.6
      patience: 1.0
      suppress_numerals: null
      suppress_tokens:
      - -1
      temperature: 0
      temperature_increment_on_fallback: 0.2
    batch_size: 8
    compute_type: int8
    device: cpu
    device_index: 0
    diarize:
      diarize: true
      model_path: /models/diarization.generated.yaml
      max_speakers: null
      min_speakers: null
    hf_token: null
    language: de
    model: large-v3
    model_dir: null
    model_variant: whisperx
    print_progress: true
    threads: 4
    vad:
      chunk_size: 30
      vad_offset: 0.363
      vad_onset: 0.5
    verbose: true

===== fs-watcher.default.yml =====
database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/fs-watcher.dev.db'

extract_dir: '/data/extract'

jobs:
  worker: 2

logging:
  version: 1
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  log_dir: /data/logs
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG

message_queue:
  name: fs-watcher-dev
  host: redis
  port: 6379

watching:
  - dir: '/mnt'
    only_files: true
    recursive: false
    formats:
      - txt
      - srt
    filter:
      - pattern: '\.mp3$'
        allow: true
      - pattern: '\.mp4$'
        allow: true
      - pattern: '\.avi$'
        allow: true
      - pattern: '\.wav$'
        allow: true

===== notify-service.default.yml =====
generator_dir: /tmp/generator
logging:
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  formatters:
    simple:
      datefmt: null
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
      style: null
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  log_dir: null
  loggers: null
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: INFO
  version: 1

mail:
  host: TODO
  port: 25
  domains:
  - TODO
  mail_from: audiominer@TODO
  subject: "[AudioMiner-DEV] 🔊➡️📄 {filename}"
  content: "Hallo,

die transkribierten Dateien befinden sich im Anhang. 


Sie können Ihre Inhalte auch für 24 Stunden unter https://audiominer.TODO einsehen. 
(Wichtig: Sie müssen den selben Browser verwenden mit dem Sie den Auftrag geschickt haben.)


Viele Grüße

Ihr AudioMiner"

observation.command: cd deployments/example-opencode && for f in compose.yml compose.cpu.yml compose.gpu.yml .env-example web-service.default.yml asr-service.cpu.default.yml fs-watcher.default.yml notify-service.default.yml; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done
